Solxce uses your location in the background and foreground to accurately track your outdoor run routes, distance, splits, elevation, and live GPS telemetry.
Solxce requires location access to map your outdoor running paths, track real-time pace, and calculate workout distance.
Solxce requires continuous background location access to map and record your long-distance running workouts even when your phone is locked.
Solxce uses your camera to scan meals for instant AI macro nutrition logging and capture workout progress media.
Solxce uses the microphone to record audio with workout video reels and capture voice notes for coaching logs.
Solxce allows you to select and share workout photos and video reels with the community.
Solxce requires permission to save exported workout summaries, milestone graphics, and run recap cards to your photo library.
Solxce reads your heart rate, active energy, resting metabolic rate, and steps to provide personalized athletic coaching telemetry.
Solxce writes completed workouts, running sessions, and nutritional intake to Apple Health.
Solxce uses pedometer and motion data to measure running cadence, step frequency, and activity metrics during training.
Solxce uses Bluetooth to connect to heart rate monitors, smart sensors, and fitness wearables during training sessions.
Solxce requires Bluetooth access to discover and pair with fitness accessories and chest straps.
Solxce lets you sync planned training sessions and athletic workouts directly to your calendar.
Solxce needs calendar access to schedule, modify, and synchronize your upcoming workout events.
Solxce sets reminders for scheduled training runs, workout sessions, and hydration goals.
Solxce manages training reminders and daily habit checklists.
Solxce lets you attach soundtrack cues and preview motivational tracks during workouts.
Solxce uses Face ID to securely authenticate athlete profiles and protect private workout and health data.
Solxce uses speech recognition to transcribe hands-free voice coaching notes and spoken workout logs.
